versions.changelog: Constrain agent messaging and tasks: incoming content is untrusted and review-only; message sending, task creation, and automatic task execution are explicitly out of scope.
Safety hardening: require explicit approval for follow/copy/signal mutations and recurring monitoring; disable auto-sync examples; use bounded heartbeat examples and secret-manager token handling.

Initial full-suite fork of ai-trader@1.0.0. Includes copy-trading, trade sync, heartbeat, Polymarket, and market-intelligence references; adds explicit approval gates, secure credential handling, and upstream attribution.
